concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-paysafecard-customer-data-exchange]] — 2026-09-15-captured MyPaySafeCard Customer Data Exchange guide for conditional identity-data use, Auth. flow, details/webhook owner fields, 24-hour authorization hold, and merchant cancel-or-capture decision.
warnings: The legal-obligation framing is conditional; the source does not determine a merchant's legal duty or identity-match policy.
Authorised and AUTHORISATION payloads represent authorization and data delivery, not a completed merchant comparison or capture.
The any-currency-account configuration statement is not payment-currency acceptance for every merchant.
